title: Adaptive Responses to Overfeeding and Weight
brief_summary: To more effectively address the problem of weight regain following weight loss for obese individuals, this study will evaluate the underlying biology of the reduced obese state. In depth studies of appetite, energy expenditure, physical activity levels and fat metabolism will be completed in obese and reduced obese individuals; with the latter subdivided into those who have lost weight with diet alone or diet plus exercise. Individuals will be studied following a brief overfeeding period to better understand how differences in biological responses to overeating might be involved in promoting or protecting against weight gain.
